title: Some instinct, waking at these memories, stronger than education or piety, quickened within him at every near approach to that life, an instinct subtle and hostile, and armed him against acquiescence.
html_source:
No matter how much he is taught what he ought to do, his instincts will always win out.

His schooling has been pointed towards a religious occupation (and satisfaction in that), but the tendencies of his personality lead him towards isolation and searching.
